about: Hand-written questions with gold passages. Every gold snippet was found in the corpus by searching the processed text, and `npm run eval` re-checks that each one exists in its book before scoring. A retrieved chunk is a hit if it is from the gold book and contains any gold snippet (whitespace, quote style and case normalized). Types: direct (uses names and wording close to the text), paraphrased (names allowed, wording deliberately different from the text), name-free (no character names or titles), cross-book (a name or idea that appears in more than one book in the corpus).
